lookup_khot_embedding_by_atomic_number: look up the k-hot elemental embedding vector for a given atomic number from KHOT_EMBEDDINGS
iterate_khot_embeddings: iterate over all k-hot elemental embeddings in the KHOT_EMBEDDINGS dictionary by atomic number
check_embedding_dimension: check the dimension of k-hot embedding vectors by inspecting the length of any entry in KHOT_EMBEDDINGS
count_active_features: count the number of active (1) features in a k-hot embedding vector for a specific element
compare_embeddings: compare k-hot embedding vectors between two elements by looking up their atomic numbers in KHOT_EMBEDDINGS
